capability_data_gaps_closed.note: discover_executable_jurisdictions()'s match_capability() returns production_capable=False unconditionally when a jurisdiction has no jurisdiction_comparison.py profile at all -- a genuine, pre-existing data gap (not a discovery-logic change) that was silently rejecting India/Peru/Uruguay at the capability gate even after their doctrines were canonicalized. Minimal capability profiles added for all three (general geographic/industry knowledge, disclosed as such, not primary-sourced production-infrastructure data) so their real, primary-sourced economic doctrine reaches production-capability assessment.

base_pricing_closeout.note: Every remaining unpriceable candidate in the FVD representative evaluation carries an EXACT terminal reason (RULE_REJECTED/STATUTORY_CONDITIONS_UNMET, FEASIBILITY_REVIEW_REQUIRED for NON_GUARANTEED_SELECTIVE/NON_ECONOMIC-classified programs, or UNPRICEABLE_AUTHORITY_INSUFFICIENT for the remaining 68 genuinely zero-evidence programs) -- never a generic/unexplained bucket.
